DeviceSessionSnapshot.title: DeviceSessionSnapshot
DeviceSessionSnapshot.description: The device-session value projection a renderer binding consumes: session identity, owning tenant scope, and the W011 device descriptor (capabilities/limits as typed data).

DeviceSessionId.title: DeviceSessionId
DeviceSessionId.description: Device-session identifier (mirrored shared primitive; canonical home @epoch/experience-runtime): "ds-" + lowercase slug.

TenantScope.title: TenantScope
TenantScope.description: Tenant scoping of an experience document: owning tenant, optional workspace and project narrowing.

OpaqueScopeId.title: OpaqueScopeId
OpaqueScopeId.description: Opaque scoping identifier (tenant/workspace/project/participant); bounded, neutral charset.

DeviceDescriptor.title: DeviceDescriptor
DeviceDescriptor.description: Abstract, provider-neutral device descriptor: capabilities and budgets as typed data; filled/adapted by renderer/device adaptation (W019).

DeviceClass.title: DeviceClass
DeviceClass.description: Neutral device class of a device descriptor (never a vendor product).

InteractionModality.title: InteractionModality
InteractionModality.description: Neutral interaction modality of a device.

DeviceDisplayCapabilities.title: DeviceDisplayCapabilities
DeviceDisplayCapabilities.description: Neutral display capabilities and budgets of a device descriptor.

DeviceSpatialCapabilities.title: DeviceSpatialCapabilities
DeviceSpatialCapabilities.description: Neutral spatial capabilities and budgets of a device descriptor.

PoseTrackingKind.title: PoseTrackingKind
PoseTrackingKind.description: Neutral pose-tracking capability of a device.
